name: Yo Dawg
aka: Yo Dawg I Heard You Like
look: Rapper Xzibit, with cornrows and a goatee, laughs with a wide toothy grin and squinted eyes. He wears a black T-shirt and a silver chain necklace in front of a mottled blue and gray photo backdrop.
use: Jokes about recursion, or putting a thing inside the same kind of thing. The top caption reads "Yo dawg, I heard you like X" and the bottom finishes "so I put an X in your X so you can Y while you Y."
slots: top caption: 'Yo dawg, I heard you like...'
bottom caption: 'so I put a ... in your ... so you can ... while you ...'
examples: Yo dawg, I heard you like naps
So I scheduled a nap in your nap so you can rest while you rest
Yo dawg, I heard you like meetings
So we booked a meeting to plan your meetings
describe: rapper with cornrows laughing in a black t shirt
xzibit smiling big with a silver chain
pimp my ride host laughing at the camera
guy with braids and a goatee grinning
laughing man in front of a blue backdrop who heard you like something
origin: Based on rapper Xzibit, host of MTV's Pimp My Ride, a show that fitted cars with over-the-top extras.
